references.text: Also describes the pursuit of places of honor and greetings in the marketplaces as signs of hypocrisy.
Condemns the Pharisees for their desire for the best seats in the synagogues and greetings in the marketplaces.
Warns against scribes who want to walk around in long robes, love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.
Warns against those who call evil good and good evil, which can be related to hypocrisy and false piety.
